title: Password Reset & Account Lockout — Active Directory
error_codes: Error: The referenced account is currently locked out
Error: Your account has been disabled
Error: The user's password must be changed before signing in
Error: Your credentials did not work
prerequisites: Access to registered mobile phone for MFA
diagnostic_questions: Are you trying to log in to your laptop or a web application?
Have you recently changed your password?
Do you have access to your registered phone for verification?
Are you getting a specific error message on the login screen?

diagnostic_tools.purpose: Check if account is locked, disabled, or password expired

resolution_steps.action: First, let's determine if your account is locked or if the password is expired. Please try logging into the self-service password reset portal at passwordreset.corporate.com from your phone or another device.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Were you able to access the password reset portal?

resolution_steps.action: Follow the password reset flow: 1) Enter your corporate email, 2) Verify your identity via the MFA prompt on your phone, 3) Create a new password (minimum 12 characters, must include uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character).
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did you successfully set a new password?

resolution_steps.action: If the self-service portal is not working, your account may be disabled or you may not have MFA registered. This requires a manual identity verification by our support team.
After resetting your password, wait 5 minutes for the change to propagate across all systems. Then try logging in. If you're on VPN, disconnect and reconnect after the password change.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Are you now able to log in with your new password?

escalation_criteria: If self-service reset fails and manual verification is needed, or if account appears disabled
